suggestion.pt: O contrato de aluguel termina em 62 dias. Podemos iniciar as negociações agora?
suggestion.en: The lease agreement ends in 62 days. Shall we start negotiations now?
suggestion.he: חוזה השכירות מסתיים בעוד 62 ימים. נוכל להתחיל במשא ומתן עכשיו?

suggestion.pt: Seu passaporte vence em 7 meses. Deseja que eu prepare a renovação?
suggestion.en: Your passport expires in 7 months. Would you like me to prepare the renewal?
suggestion.he: הדרכון שלך פג תוקף בעוד 7 חודשים. להכין את החידוש?

suggestion.pt: A fatura mensal da DEWA vence em breve. Deseja que eu confirme o débito e verifique os leiturados?
suggestion.en: The monthly DEWA bill is due soon. Would you like me to verify readings and confirm auto-pay?
suggestion.he: חשבון DEWA החודשי מגיע לפירעון בקרוב. לאשר את קריאות המונה ולתאם תשלום?

suggestion.pt: Este restaurante fica lotado toda sexta. Quer que eu reserve a mesa da próxima semana?
suggestion.en: This restaurant gets fully booked every Friday. Would you like me to reserve a table for next week?
suggestion.he: מסעדה זו מלאה בכל יום שישי. לעשות הזמנה לשבוע הבא?
